name: Qoder JetBrains Plugin
desc: Qoder coding agent inside JetBrains IDEs
desc_zh: 装进 JetBrains 系列 IDE 的智能体编程插件
solves: Switching editors to use an AI assistant breaks focus; completion, Ask and Agent now run in the same IDE.
solves_zh: 为了用智能体编程要换编辑器，现在补全、问答和 Agent 都在原来的 IDE 里。
best_for: You work in IntelliJ IDEA or PyCharm and want an agent to plan and edit the open project.
best_for_zh: 你日常用 IntelliJ IDEA 或 PyCharm，想让智能体直接在当前项目里规划和改代码。
